APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS: Complete the inherited Terraform and Kubernetes EKS add-on trust rollout system at `/app` using contracts in `/app/docs` and incident evidence in `/app/evidence` so add-on controllers, IRSA subjects, PodDisruptionBudgets, and regulated placement achieve policy-compliant upgrade readiness.
Execute and validate through the public operator CLI command at `/app/bin/addon-trust-rollout`.
Plan Terraform under `/app/terraform` so the generated plan at `/app/var/upgrade/plan.json` includes all required add-ons matching target versions in `/app/data/compatibility_matrix.json`.
Configure `resolve_conflicts_on_update = 'PRESERVE'` for all EKS add-ons in the Terraform plan.
Support SSM parameter tags for controller add-ons to extract version overrides and conflict resolution modes.
Configure each IRSA role in Terraform to trust exactly one service account subject matching `/app/data/trust_observations.json` and reject wildcards or forbidden subjects.
Ensure IAM role policies contain no wildcard actions (`*` or `ebs:*`) and role names follow required naming conventions.
Supply required PodDisruptionBudgets in `/app/k8s` matching required names, namespaces, and minAvailable thresholds in `/app/data/pdbs.json`.
Preserve `CriticalAddonsOnly=true:NoSchedule` taints and nodepool labels on the system node group.
Simulate system node draining while enforcing PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable limits and maintaining core service availability.
Enforce explicit nodepool selectors and capacity-type constraints for regulated workloads, restricting placement to private on-demand node pools.
Enforce Karpenter NodePool CRD requirements to ensure regulated capacity excludes spot instances.
Simulate spot/on-demand node interruptions and verify regulated workloads remain on on-demand capacity after rebalancing.
Validate add-on rollout prerequisites before advancing each add-on, executing rollouts in exact compatibility matrix order.
Poll and verify add-on readiness before marking steps complete, reporting status `READY` only when all readiness conditions pass.
Audit cross-service trust to prevent IAM role ARN sharing across distinct add-ons.
Merge inline policies and standalone role policy attachments in plan normalization.
Guard resources tagged `UpgradeProtected=true` against delete or replace actions in the Terraform plan.
Record step-by-step rollout state checkpoints to enable atomic restart recovery upon interruption.
Publish deterministic reports to `/app/output/upgrade-report.json` with canonical formatting, sorted keys, stable semantic fields, and repeatable SHA-256 report digests.

defects.observable_failure: Missing add-on resources in Terraform plan are ignored rather than flagged as errors.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking add-on count without validating individual names allows missing add-ons.

defects.observable_failure: Add-on versions differing from the compatibility matrix target are accepted as valid.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Comparing major version only misses minor or patch version mismatches.

defects.observable_failure: resolve_conflicts_on_update values other than PRESERVE pass plan policy validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Allowing OVERWRITE or NONE passes validation but causes cluster drift.

defects.observable_failure: Controller add-ons specified via SSM parameters fail to extract version or conflict tags correctly.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Parsing SSM parameter values without inspecting tags misses tag-driven version overrides.

defects.observable_failure: Role assume-role policy documents with nested JSON strings or interpolations fail subject extraction.
defects.partial_fix_trap: String regex searching without structural JSON decoding misses nested policy statements.

defects.observable_failure: IRSA roles trusting zero or multiple service account subjects pass trust verification.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking that required subject is in trust list without checking total subject count allows wildcard trust.

defects.observable_failure: Roles trusting forbidden subjects such as system:nodes pass trust checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Validating required service account subject without checking forbidden subject list leaks node identity.

defects.observable_failure: IAM policies containing wildcard actions (e.g. * or ebs:*) pass policy validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking statement Effect without evaluating Action patterns allows broad permissions.

defects.observable_failure: IRSA role names that do not match expected naming conventions pass role validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching AddonTrust tag alone without verifying IAM role name allows improperly named roles.

defects.observable_failure: Kubernetes PodDisruptionBudgets with missing or non-matching selector labels are recorded as valid.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking PDB name existence without matching namespace and selector labels passes invalid PDBs.

defects.observable_failure: PDB minAvailable values that differ from required defaults pass PDB coverage checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking minAvailable is non-zero without verifying exact threshold allows insufficient availability.

defects.observable_failure: System node groups missing the CriticalAddonsOnly taint pass node group validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking key name without verifying value and effect (NoSchedule) allows non-blocking taints.

defects.observable_failure: Node drain simulation evicts pods even when PDB minAvailable budgets would be violated.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Counting evicted pods without tracking remaining available replicas violates PDB safety.

defects.observable_failure: System node groups with incorrect nodepool label values pass node pool validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Verifying node group name without checking Kubernetes labels allows mislabeled pools.

defects.observable_failure: Regulated workloads configured without explicit nodepool selectors pass placement validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking namespace name without verifying pod spec nodeSelector allows unconstrained placement.

defects.observable_failure: Regulated node pools specifying spot or hybrid capacity pass placement checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Filtering capacity types without checking all configured types permits spot instances.

defects.observable_failure: Regulated node pools deployed in public or dual-stack subnets pass subnet posture checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking private subnet presence without verifying public subnet absence allows public exposure.

defects.observable_failure: Karpenter NodePool CRDs with on-demand and spot in requirements pass regulated capacity validation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reading NodePool name without evaluating template spec requirements allows spot capacity.

defects.observable_failure: Interruption simulation fails to verify that regulated workloads remain on on-demand capacity after node rebalancing.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Setting interruption handled=true without checking post-interruption placement allows spot migration.

defects.observable_failure: Add-on rollout proceeds when required prerequisite add-ons are missing or in non-ACTIVE status.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking prerequisite add-on existence without verifying ACTIVE status permits premature upgrade.

defects.observable_failure: Add-ons are upgraded out of the order defined in the compatibility matrix.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Iterating add-ons in plan dict order instead of matrix order violates rollout sequence.

defects.observable_failure: Add-on status is marked ACTIVE before controller deployment readiness checks pass.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Updating status immediately upon API request without polling readiness causes race conditions.

defects.observable_failure: Multiple add-on roles sharing the same IAM role ARN or trust subject pass cross-service isolation checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Verifying individual IRSA bindings without auditing unique role ARNs permits shared trust.

defects.observable_failure: Plan normalization drops inline role policies or standalone role policy attachments.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Parsing aws_iam_role inline_policy without merging aws_iam_role_policy attachments misses permissions.

defects.observable_failure: Resources tagged UpgradeProtected=true that are scheduled for delete or replace pass plan policy checks.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking resource address without inspecting change actions (delete/replace) allows destructive changes.

defects.observable_failure: Rollout state checkpointing fails to record step-by-step progress, causing full restart on interruption.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Writing checkpoint only at completion loses progress when rollout is interrupted.

defects.observable_failure: Upgrade report fields omit required keys or fail to sort lists and dictionary keys deterministically.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Formatting JSON without sort_keys=True causes non-deterministic report digests across runs.

defects.observable_failure: Report digest calculation includes volatile fields (e.g. timestamps or local file paths).
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hashing full report object including volatile fields produces changing digests for identical state.
